mines.mine_notes: Open pit gold mine; JV 55% TRX Gold (operator) / 45% STAMICO (Tanzanian state). FY2025 (100% basis): poured 18,935 oz (attributable 55% = 10,414 oz); sold 19,213 oz at avg realized price $3,033/oz; revenue $57.6M; cash cost $1,530/oz sold (FY2026 guidance $1,400-$1,600/oz). Q4 head grade 1.95 g/t. PEA (2024): avg 62 koz/yr over 17.6-yr life; LOM cash cost $1,024/oz, AISC $1,206/oz; $89M growth capital for underground expansion + plant upgrades targeting >80 koz/yr. No P&P reserves declared (PEA-stage). Actual FY2025 AISC not disclosed (field null).

notes: Fiscal year ended August 31, 2025 (40-F/MD&A/AIF). Production = attributable ounces (MD&A figures are Buckreef JV 100% basis). M&I resources >2.0 Moz Au (Buckreef Main Zone). All amounts in USD.
